title: The Vivienne wins UK Series 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S01-E08), The Vivienne and Divina de Campo lip-synced to Wham!'s "I'm Your Man". The Vivienne was crowned the UK's first Drag Race superstar; Divina finished as runner-up. Baga Chipz placed third. Early UK series offered no cash prize.

title: Gothy Kendoll: UK's first Porkchop
summary: Gothy Kendoll was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race UK (UK-S01-E01), lip-syncing to Dua Lipa's "New Rules" against Vinegar Strokes. Her farewell message called herself "the UK's Porkchop".

title: Break Up (Bye Bye) chart success
summary: In UK-S01-E05, the queens wrote and performed verses to "Break Up (Bye Bye)". The Frock Destroyers (Baga Chipz, Blu Hydrangea, Divina de Campo) won. The song was released as a single and reached number 35 on the UK Singles Chart.

title: First UK Snatch Game
summary: UK-S01-E04 introduced Snatch Game to the UK franchise. Baga Chipz (Margaret Thatcher) and The Vivienne (Donald Trump) both won. Sum Ting Wong was eliminated after lip-syncing to "Spice Up Your Life".
